violation_type.title: Initiating Background Checks as Specified in 26 TAC, Chapter 745, Subchapter F (26 TAC §742.307(1))
violation_type.short_title: Initiating Background Checks as Specified in 26 TAC, Chapter 745, Subchapter F
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation had frequent visitor present in the home that had direct access to children in care without a cleared background check.

finding_variants.text: The operation had frequent visitor present in the home that had direct access to children in care without a cleared background check.

Based on the evidence obtained during the DFPS investigation, there is sufficient evidence to support that both the primary caregiver and the substitute caregiver and household member do not have a current background check. The substitute caregiver moved into the home.
